notes.title: Release Upcoming!
notes.notes:
Only three days until game launch! 

That's three days to prepare your mind and body for what is to come.

For the best Hats Are Not Allowed experience I would recommend the following routine for the next 72 hours:

1. Visualize performing the perfect counter on an Elite Fighter Bot, whilst your glorious Hat burns your opponents visual input system with the unrelenting style of a thousand suns.

2. Repeat step 1.
